title: Agreement open for canonical etale inverse-image section comparisons
statement: Let R and S be schemes [def-pc-scheme], f:S\to R a morphism, G a sheaf of sets on the small etale site of R [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], and V an etale R-scheme [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Let s,t be sections of f^{-1}G over V\times_R S [def-pc-fibre-product]. There is an open U of V\times_R S such that for every scheme T and commuting triangle h:T\to S, k:T\to R with h followed by f equal to k, the canonical comparisons [def-weil-pbc-sets-section-comparison] of s and t agree if and only if the inverse image of U under (id_V,h):V\times_R T\to V\times_R S is the whole scheme. No compactness, affineness or limit hypothesis is required.

source.place: Tag 09XM (lemma-sections-equal) and Tags 03CB, 03CC: agreement opens with inverse-image composition and units; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09XM

proof.text: Apply existsUnique_etaleSections_equal_open to the sheaf f inverse image G on S and the etale object V times_R S, with the sections s and t. This uniquely specifies an open U of V times_R S by its universal factorization property for arbitrary scheme maps.

For h:T -> S with h followed by f equal to k, let P=V times_R T, Q=V times_R S, and p:P -> Q be the pullback map (id_V,h). Write q:Q -> S and qprime:P -> T for the etale second projections. Evaluation of f inverse image G on Q equals global sections of q inverse image (f inverse image G), because inverse image along an etale map is restriction. Similarly for P and qprime. The equation p followed by q = qprime followed by h, the naturality of units in etale objects, and the composition unit equation identify restriction of s,t along p with their images under etaleSetSectionComparison h f k hk G V, after these evaluation isomorphisms. This is the two paths around the cartesian square; the iterated fibre-product comparison is the one whose projections are id_V and h. Isomorphisms reflect as well as preserve equality. Thus their comparison images agree if and only if the sections in the universal factorization criterion of U agree.

Apply the factorization criterion of U to p. A scheme map factors through an open immersion if and only if all its points lie in the open (use the open immersion lifting property). This is equivalent to p inverse image U = top. These statements hold for an empty domain as well.

theorem etaleSetSectionComparison_equal_open
    {R S : Scheme.{u}} (f : S ⟶ R)
    (G : Sheaf R.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) (V : R.Etale)
    (s t : ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback f).obj G).obj.obj
      (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).obj V))) :
    ∃ U : (pullback V.hom f).Opens,
      ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (h : T ⟶ S) (k : T ⟶ R) (hk : h ≫ f = k),
        etaleSetSectionComparison h f k hk G V s =
          etaleSetSectionComparison h f k hk G V t ↔
        (pullback.map V.hom k V.hom f (𝟙 V.left) h (𝟙 R)
          (by simp) (by simpa using hk.symm)) ⁻¹ᵁ U = ⊤
